data.body: Task 153 (number 152, todo): rework the Chat tool-call card. Header keeps icon + status chip and the capability id plus a bracketed real tool name (tool.shell.host (bash)); input becomes a formatted one-line argument summary with a capped scrollable expand; output shows the tool's own text, streaming incrementally, 4 rows default / 10 expanded with auto-scroll; non-text output renders an image or a compact status. Grounding: ConversationTimeline.tsx TimelineCard + ActivityData (the raw <dl class="activity-data"> JSON), activityProjection.ts spanItem/toolImageAttachments, styles.css. Streaming needs no new backend contract: ModelToolEventV1::Progress -> content_delta("progress") in run_events.rs ~L1212 already reaches span.progress and the live card body. Linked to design element aworkit.desktop_ui.conversation. Decisions: static capabilityId->display-name map with fallback; Run details unchanged and still the home of exact redacted JSON.
